people.name: Cornelius
people.line: Centurion, first Gentile convert to Christianity

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

people.name: Simon
people.line: A tanner in Joppa who hosted Peter.

translations.web: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
translations.bsb: While Peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house and approached the gate.
translations.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
